title: Executive Summary
text: Audience growth accelerated during media exposure and release activities with sustained engagement throughout the campaign.

title: Core Audience
text: Users aged 25–34 represent the largest and most engaged audience segment.

title: Secondary Audience
text: The 35–44 segment consistently contributed to long-term engagement.

title: Regional Hub
text: Berlin generated the highest audience concentration and the strongest campaign response.

title: Growth Market
text: Hamburg showed strong secondary growth and should remain a strategic focus.

title: Primary Growth Driver
text: The release week generated the largest increase in followers and reach.

title: Media Impact
text: The TV appearance delivered the strongest short-term visibility boost.

title: Organic Momentum
text: Organic sharing amplified campaign performance after the initial media push.

title: Campaign Peak
text: The campaign reached its highest engagement during release week.

title: Audience Lift
text: TV exposure created the largest daily increase in followers.

title: Recommendation
text: Future campaigns should combine release moments with TV exposure and regional targeting in Berlin and Hamburg.

title: Risk
text: Long periods without content after campaign peaks may reduce engagement and slow audience growth.
